nodes.name: Receive Input
nodes.notes: Formal input contract for this sub-workflow: workflow_run_id + images_json (the object produced by 'Arya OS - Image Generation', containing storyboard_id + an images array).

nodes.name: Loop
nodes.notes: Splits images_json.images into one item per shot image. Every downstream node runs once per item automatically (n8n's normal per-item execution model) — same pattern as the Image Generation workflow's loop. Swap for a 'Loop Over Items' (Split In Batches, batchSize=1) node if per-shot rate-limiting is ever needed against a real image-to-video provider.

nodes.name: Video API Placeholder
nodes.notes: PLACEHOLDER endpoint — no real image-to-video provider is wired in yet (backend/app/providers/capabilities.py reserves 'fal' and 'comfyui' for VIDEO_GENERATION, but no HTTP client exists for either). Runs once per shot image automatically. continueOnFail is enabled so one failed clip doesn't abort video generation for every other shot. TODO: same provider-routing bypass as Image Generation — the backend's ProviderRouter is not invoked from here. Not fixed (would be a redesign), flagged for a future decision. retryOnFail added (3 tries, 2s apart).

nodes.name: Set - Collect Video Clips

assignments.name: clip_result
assignments.value: ={{ { shot_number: $('Loop').item.json.image.shot_number ?? null, storage_path: $json.storage_path ?? 'PLACEHOLDER_CLIP_STORAGE_PATH', duration_seconds: $json.duration_seconds ?? null, provider_name: $json.provider_name ?? 'PLACEHOLDER_PROVIDER', error: $json.error ?? null } }}

nodes.notes: Normalizes each per-shot clip response into a stable shape — matches backend/app/models/media.py's GeneratedVideo table fields (one row per shot clip, distinct from the final assembled Video).

nodes.name: Aggregate - Combine Clips
nodes.notes: Combines all per-shot 'clip_result' items back into a single 'clips' array in one item — the per-shot loop ends here, ready for final assembly into one video.

nodes.name: HTTP Request - Merge Clips API (Placeholder)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ workflow_run_id: $json.workflow_run_id ?? $('Receive Input').item.json.workflow_run_id, storyboard_id: $('Receive Input').item.json.images_json.storyboard_id, clips: ($json.clips ?? []).map(c => c.clip_result).sort((a, b) => (a.shot_number ?? 0) - (b.shot_number ?? 0)) }) }}

nodes.notes: TODO: BACKEND ENDPOINT MISSING — 'POST /api/agents/video-merge' does not exist today. Do not fabricate it. Host fixed to host.docker.internal. Credential now references the shared 'arya_backend_shared_secret' httpHeaderAuth credential. retryOnFail added (3 tries, 2s apart); continueOnFail stays on so a missing endpoint returns a structured error in video_json rather than crashing the pipeline.

nodes.name: Return video_json

assignments.name: video_json
assignments.value: ={{ { workflow_run_id: $('Receive Input').item.json.workflow_run_id, video_id: $json.video_id ?? 'PLACEHOLDER_VIDEO_ID', storage_path: $json.storage_path ?? 'PLACEHOLDER_VIDEO_STORAGE_PATH', duration_seconds: $json.duration_seconds ?? null, clip_count: Array.isArray($json.clips) ? $json.clips.length : null, error: $json.error ?? null } }}

nodes.notes: Final output contract for this sub-workflow: a single top-level 'video_json' object, consumed by the Main Orchestrator's Execute Workflow node. FIXED: now also preserves workflow_run_id (was missing from output).

meta.notes: Sprint 1-3 scaffold sub-workflow. Input contract: workflow_run_id + images_json. Loops over images_json.images (one image-to-video HTTP call per shot), collects the resulting clips, then makes a separate placeholder call to merge/stitch them into one final video — mirroring the backend's own GeneratedVideo (per-shot) vs Video (final assembled) distinction. No real video provider or merge service is wired in yet (VideoAgent in backend/app/agents/video.py is still a NotImplementedError stub), and no AI/editing logic runs inside n8n itself — every step here only calls placeholder HTTP endpoints. Output contract: a single top-level 'video_json' object, intended to be called via Execute Workflow from 'Arya OS - Main Orchestrator'.
